correctness.rationale: Independently regenerated all 11 vertices and 20 edges of µ(C5), its 102 nonempty independent faces (vector 11,35,40,15,1), and checked the classification for all 2^11−1=2047 nonempty W, with five nine-vertex cores, five ten-vertex supersets and the full 11-set. Directly fetched certificate Git blob 068acf4065d0b93272fb351a26f451a230a096fb and independently replayed all seven exact ordered collapse sequences: ambient→core 27 pairs, core→sphere 2, root deletion→point 45, original deletion→point 41, two twin deletion→core 11 each, nonconsecutive triple→point 25; every removal was a free codimension-one face with unique maximal coface and expected remainder. The resulting (9,21,14) surface has connected cyclic links and χ=2, hence S². All bad sets lie within one of contractible deletion or nonconsecutive-triple supersets, so inclusions factor nullhomotopically. D5 sign obtained by signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz as in source. No claim that the bad induced subcomplexes themselves are contractible.
